context: Wilde to George Ives, postmarked 21 March 1898, Paris. Two months out of prison and three weeks into the Ballad's fifth edition, answering Ives on law reform. It is the closest Wilde comes on paper to a political programme: repeal, and the road to it.
quote:
Hotel de Nice, Rue des Beaux Arts

My dear George, Thanks so much for your letter: your charming friend came to see me one morning at the hotel — and was most delightful. I hope to see him again in a few days — He does seem quite fascinated by Paris.

Thanks so much for ordering my book — it is now in its fifth edition. Smithers has put a flaming advertisement into the Athenaeum. Headed ‘3000 copies sold in three weeks’ — when I read it I feel like Lipton’s tea —!

Yes! I have no doubt we shall win — but the road is long, and red with monstrous martyrdoms — Nothing but the repeal of the Criminal Law Amendment Act would do any good. That is the essential. It is not so much public opinion, as public officials that need educating. Ever yours Oscar
original_provenance: Read at HRC 2700, images 1-2. One bifolium: image 1 shows side 4 (left) and side 1 (right), image 2 the inner opening, sides 2 and 3; images 3-4 are the envelope. Emphasis: none - nothing is underlined on any of the four sides, a null finding, and it covers 'Criminal Law Amendment Act', which is unmarked. The volume sets 'Athenaeum' in italic; that is the editor's convention for a journal title, not a mark Wilde made, and it is not carried here. Punctuation: six dashes restored, all of them his and not line-break artefacts. Reading: 'flaming' is confirmed at 7x - the initial letter carries the descender loop of his 'f', not the ascender-only 'b' it resembles at page size. 'into the Athenaeum. Headed' (comma and lower case in the volume), 'Lipton's Tea -!' (the dash is dropped in the volume), 'Yes!... we shall win - but' (the volume gives a colon and a comma), and the comma in 'public opinion, as public officials'. Envelope (images 3-4): addressed 'Monsieur, M. George Ives, Hotel Victoria, Nice, (Alpes-Maritimes)' with 'Nice' double-underlined; Paris 21 Mars 98 Av. de l'Opera postmark, which is the volume's date; docketed on the verso by Ives, 'W 21 Mar 98' and 'Oscar Wilde' underlined down the left edge. Layout, checked on the printed page: the volume sets ‘3000 copies sold in three weeks’ as a centred display line on its own, not run into the paragraph. The quote here runs it inline. Whether the sheet displays it or runs it on has not been examined closely. 1173 - stand, because there the edition read a real difference.
